_comment: Task 1.7: systems of furnace. Offsets in light-years from the region center (D12). Planets come in tasks 1.8 and 1.9.

systems.name: Crucible (WIP)
systems.notes: Young blue star at the heart of the nebula. Its radiation blinds sensors and burns out unshielded electronics.

systems.name: Anvil (WIP)
systems.notes: Wolf-Rayet star shedding its outer layers in fierce winds and jets.

systems.name: Tuyere (WIP)
systems.notes: Young blue-white star with worlds still forming in the dust around it.

systems.name: Quench (WIP)
systems.notes: Protostar still gathering mass, wrapped in its forming disk.

systems.name: Clinker (WIP)
systems.notes: Protostar deep in the nebula, known mostly from Gatherers' Guild charts.

systems.name: Bloom (WIP)
systems.notes: Young blue-white star, bright through the nebula.
